name: flowcity
description: FlowCity : construis ta ville, automatise ta vie. Un bac à sable façon SimCity pour apprendre et créer des workflows (Gmail, Drive, Slack, Notion, IA…).
author: FlowCity

scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npx --yes electron-builder@25.1.8 --win nsis portable
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npx --yes electron-builder@25.1.8 --mac dmg
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npx --yes electron-builder@25.1.8 --linux AppImage
scripts.check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/store.cjs && node --check electron/google.cjs && node --check electron/connectors.cjs && node --check electron/assistant.cjs && node --check scripts/launch.cjs && node --test "tests/*.test.mjs" && vite build
